info.name: Mend Access Management Asynchronous Process Control API

params.name: orgToken
params.description: org UUID (by running Entities - Organization > Get User Organizations) or API Key (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **API Key**).

items.docs:
Returns the status of an asynchronous process. Asynchronous processes allow requests to be performed in
 the background, enabling you to initiate tasks and check their completion status later.

 **Requests Performed in Async Process:**
+ Post Apply OrganizationPolicies On Inventory.
+ Post Apply Product Policies On Inventory.
+ Post Apply Project Policies On Inventory.
